scheme_name: Skill Development Training - 90 Days Skill Development Training Programme in Curtain & Garment Stitching
description:
The Skill Development Training Programme in Curtain and Garment Stitching is a government initiative aimed at enhancing the employability of individuals in the textile and garment sector.

This scheme was launched in 2015 as part of the broader Skill India Mission initiated by the Government of India.

The Skill India Mission aims to train over 400 million people in various skills by the year 2022.

The specific objective of the 90 Days Skill Development Training Programme is to provide practical training in curtain and garment stitching to individuals, enabling them to secure employment or become self-employed.

The programme is designed to equip participants with the necessary skills to meet the demands of the textile industry.

The training is structured to last for a total of 90 days, which is approximately three months.

During this period, participants receive hands-on training in various aspects of garment stitching, including pattern making, fabric cutting, and sewing techniques.

The training also covers the basics of quality control and finishing processes in garment production.

The programme aims to train at least 10,000 individuals annually across various states in India.

Participants are expected to achieve a minimum competency level of 80 percent in practical assessments to qualify for certification.

The benefits of this programme include not only skill development but also the provision of a stipend to participants.

Each participant is entitled to receive a stipend of INR 500 per month during the training period.

This stipend is aimed at supporting individuals financially while they acquire new skills.

Upon successful completion of the training, participants receive a certificate of competency from the National Skill Development Corporation.

This certification is recognized across the industry and enhances the employability of the trainees.

Eligibility criteria for the programme include individuals aged between 18 and 35 years.

Candidates must have completed at least the 8th grade of schooling to be eligible for enrollment.

There are no specific income criteria for applicants, making the programme accessible to all individuals within the specified age group.

The application process for the Skill Development Training Programme is straightforward and involves several steps.

Interested candidates must first locate a training center that offers the programme.

These centers are typically affiliated with the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.

Once a training center is identified, candidates must fill out an application form available at the center or online.

The application form requires basic personal information, educational qualifications, and contact details.

Candidates must also submit a copy of their educational certificates and a government-issued identity proof.

After submission, the training center will review the applications and conduct an orientation session for selected candidates.

The orientation session provides details about the training schedule, curriculum, and expectations.

Training sessions are usually conducted in batches, with each batch comprising 20 to 30 participants.

The training is conducted by qualified instructors with experience in the garment industry.

Classes typically take place five days a week, with each session lasting approximately six hours.

The training includes both theoretical and practical components to ensure comprehensive skill development.

Participants are encouraged to engage in hands-on practice to reinforce their learning.

The programme also includes guest lectures from industry professionals to provide insights into the garment sector.

Disbursement of the stipend occurs at the end of each month during the training period.

Participants must maintain attendance of at least 75 percent to qualify for stipend disbursement.

The programme is implemented by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.

The National Skill Development Corporation serves as the primary agency overseeing the execution of the training programme.

Contact details for inquiries can be found on the official website of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.

The programme is part of a larger effort to boost the textile and garment sector in India, which is a significant contributor to the country's economy.

The textile industry in India employs over 45 million people and is expected to grow significantly in the coming years.

The Skill Development Training Programme aims to bridge the skill gap in this industry by providing targeted training.

Statistics indicate that the demand for skilled workers in the textile sector is projected to increase by 30 percent by 2025.

This programme is also aligned with the Make in India initiative, which encourages domestic manufacturing.

The government has allocated substantial funds to support skill development initiatives across various sectors.

In the financial year 2021-2022, the government allocated INR 3,000 crores for skill development programmes.

The Skill Development Training Programme in Curtain and Garment Stitching is one of many initiatives aimed at empowering the youth of India.

By providing practical skills, the programme aims to reduce unemployment rates among young individuals.

The programme also encourages entrepreneurship by equipping trainees with the skills needed to start their own businesses.

In addition to garment stitching, the training may also cover related skills such as fabric selection and design basics.

The programme is designed to be inclusive, welcoming participants from diverse backgrounds.

Efforts are made to ensure that women and marginalized communities are adequately represented in the training sessions.

The government actively promotes this programme through various outreach initiatives to raise awareness.

Local NGOs and community organizations often collaborate with the government to facilitate training sessions.

Feedback from participants is collected to continuously improve the training curriculum and delivery methods.

The success of the programme is measured through follow-up surveys to track employment outcomes of graduates.

Overall, the Skill Development Training Programme in Curtain and Garment Stitching represents a significant effort by the Indian government to enhance skills and promote employment in the textile sector.

By focusing on practical training and industry relevance, the programme aims to create a skilled workforce ready to meet the demands of the evolving job market.
